items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Well, like, you know, Mr. Moon, Bright and Silver, Silvery Moon.

ctx.x: Those family get-togethers, you say, when your father played with the broom there. What kind of songs did you play here? Can you remember any of the names of the tunes or anything?

Well, let me see. I could, if I could think. Well, like, you know, Mr. Moon, Bright and Silver, Silvery Moon. Oh, yeah. That's a green shining light on me. Well, that's one of them. Yeah. And, uh, it was such old numbers, I can't quite remember them right off hand.
But they'd be popular tunes that you'd, uh, try?
